The text updates are brilliant too, very helpful to be reminded. The receptionists are always nice and helpful. The best thing about this practice? Hands down… some of the GPs. I don’t ever feel fobbed off or rushed out like some doctors have made me feel in the past, like I’m an inconvenience and not taken seriously..
